quotes.text: A cached Calendar reset must await `calICalendarProvider.deleteCalendar()` before it reuses storage. The later fix also clears item and recurrence caches after deletion, keeps offline flag caches that have no refill path, and checks whether the calendar was unregistered during the await. The provider API now returns a promise for completed deletion. https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-deskt
